title: Current Density Expression
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly derive and present the expression for the current density induced by the electric field.

title: Wave Equation Derivation
description: Important Criteria: The student should derive the wave equation for the electric field in the medium, including the necessary terms from Maxwell's equations.

title: Propagation Condition
description: Essential Criteria: The student must state the condition for electromagnetic wave propagation in the medium, specifically that omega squared is greater than omega_P squared.

title: Final Condition Expression
description: Essential Criteria: The student must provide the inequality relating electron density to the other parameters for indefinite wave propagation.

title: Mathematical Consistency
description: Important Criteria: The student should ensure that all mathematical manipulations are consistent and correctly applied throughout the solution.

title: Unit Analysis
description: Optional Criteria: The student may include a check of units in the final expressions to confirm dimensional consistency.

title: Common Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should avoid common errors such as sign mistakes or neglecting factors in the equations.

title: Neglecting Interactions
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must acknowledge the assumption of neglecting interactions between electrons, which is critical for the derivation.
